summary.id: Pilar iman pertama: beriman kepada Allah dengan mengenal keesaan dan kesempurnaan-Nya.
summary.en: The first pillar of faith: believing in Allah, His oneness, and His perfection.

text.id: Iman kepada Allah berarti meyakini keberadaan dan keesaan-Nya, menerima nama dan sifat-Nya sebagaimana dijelaskan dalam wahyu, serta mengarahkan ibadah hanya kepada-Nya.
text.en: Faith in Allah means believing in His existence and oneness, affirming His names and attributes as described in revelation, and directing worship to Him alone.

body.id: Iman kepada Allah membimbing seorang Muslim untuk mencintai, menaati, berharap, dan bertawakal kepada-Nya.
body.en: Faith in Allah guides a Muslim to love, obey, hope in, and rely upon Him.

label.id: Saya memahami dasar iman kepada Allah.
label.en: I understand the foundation of faith in Allah.
